parent_objective: implement and run frozen-actor head-only capability objective smoke

public_gates: train capability head on frozen BC5660 hidden state
verify actor parameters are unchanged and output is unpromoted
forbidden_shortcuts: do not feed capability labels to actor inputs
do not claim driver improvement from head-only loss
hypothesis: The M596 capability corpus contains learnable future-response signal in BC5660 base hidden states, so a frozen-actor capability head should reduce regression and ranking losses without changing policy behavior.
success_criteria: runner writes capability_head.pt train_metrics.csv validation_metrics.csv and summary.json
train regression loss drops at least 30 percent
validation regression loss drops at least 10 percent
train ranking loss drops at least 10 percent
validation ranking loss does not increase more than 10 percent
actor_parameters_changed is false and action-anchor MSE is <= 1e-8
failure_criteria: loss metrics do not meet smoke thresholds
checkpoint is promoted or PPO is run

commands.name: smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.bc_capability_repair_smoke --train-corpus runs/m596_bc_capability_corpus_train_smoke/capability_corpus.npz --train-pairs runs/m596_bc_capability_corpus_train_smoke/pairs.csv --val-corpus runs/m596_bc_capability_corpus_validation_smoke/capability_corpus.npz --val-pairs runs/m596_bc_capability_corpus_validation_smoke/pairs.csv --base-checkpoint runs/m568_scaled_l3_bc_seed5660/checkpoint.pt --epochs 200 --learning-rate 0.003 --rank-loss-weight 0.25 --seed 5980 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m598_bc_capability_repair_head_only_smoke

decision_rule: M598 passes if the frozen-actor capability-head smoke meets the pre-registered objective thresholds while keeping actor parameters unchanged and making no driver-performance claim.
